DELIVERED + codex-APPROVED (8 review rounds). Commits 5d6cad61 -> b83116b8 -> 0173cd3c -> 26ae63fa -> 033af065 -> 9c858057 -> fbc02b5e.
Object-log SEGMENT-OBJECT reclamation now works behind a bounded-recovery retention floor, gated by async-apply debt,
WITHOUT regressing the proven AC-TXN-3 unknown-outcome-request_id-replay-across-restart guarantee. This closes the last
AC-TXN-5A GAP -> object_log_sqlite(hybrid-async) is now PASS (no GAP).

DESIGN (validated by a design pass, simpler than the bead's snapshot framing):
- Floor = min(projection checkpoint recovery_high_water, max visible_last_seq over the CONTIGUOUS PREFIX of data
  segments whose committed_at_ms <= now - request_id_retention_ms - 5s skew). created_at <= committed_at_ms by
  causality (group-commit AND raw-append seals stamp committed_at_ms = max(created_at over the drained batch)), so a
  segment below the floor holds ONLY expired request_ids -> no idempotency snapshot needed.
- The floor is an ATOMIC, epoch-fenced MANIFEST ENTRY (retention_floor_through) advanced via the same create-only
  put_if_absent CAS as data/fence commits (a superseded owner loses the CAS -> cannot regress it). Recovery derives the
  floor from the max floor entry; the idempotency folds + projection replay start at max(resolve_recovery_start, floor).
- Reclamation runs after reap_terminal_items_locked under the async-apply-debt gate (retention_may_advance); crash-safe
  order = write floor (CAS) then delete segment objects; a crash-interrupted deletion is finished on the next tick
  (Option-semantic watermark). Recovery FAILS CLOSED if the projection image is behind the floor (no silent data loss).

AC-TXN-3 PRESERVED on BOTH write paths (group-commit + raw-append): a within-retention request_id's segment is provably
never age-trimmed (retained -> replays across trim+restart); an after-retention retry is correctly fresh. commit_transition
across-trim is genuine capability-N/A on this eventual-apply backend (Unavailable, is_atomic()==false).

Codex adversarial review (8 rounds) found and I sent back + fixed, before APPROVE: AC-TXN-3 regression on the raw-append
path (committed_at=0) AND the group-commit batch (now_ms vs batch-max); crash-interrupted-deletion leak + floor-0 edge;
cross-owner floor-regression TOCTOU (now the manifest CAS); behind-image silent data loss (now fail-closed); branch-over-a-
trimmed-log missing-segment (branch inherits the source floor); branch-vs-concurrent-trim race (pin-first + validate-after-copy
fail-closed); branch-creation error-path corruption (objects-first/pin-last rollback + funnel all post-pin failures); and
finally the whole partial/failed-branch corruption CLASS closed structurally (branch.json atomic commit marker written LAST +
a branch.pending sentinel; an uncommitted branch is NON-READABLE, so it can never GET a segment regardless of
pin/TTL/store-failure). Final codex verdict: APPROVE — no remaining blocking correctness bug; no data-loss/missing-segment/
recovery-poison/corrupt-branch path across crash, cross-owner takeover, behind-image, branch concurrency, and compound
branch-creation store failures.

Tests: 27 objectlog substrate + 15 dedicated reclamation tests (reclamation, withheld-under-Hard, within/after-retention replay
across trim+restart on group-commit AND raw paths, recovery-from-floor == no-trim control, R1 floored replay, floor-0 crash,
released-pin re-scan, epoch-fenced manifest-CAS takeover, behind-image fail-closed, group-commit batch-max, branch inherits
floor, branch-vs-concurrent-trim fail-closed, post-pin store-failure fault matrix, compound-fault-no-missing-segment,
committed-branch readable+protected). Full -p pqueue-objectlog -p pqueue-sqlite -p pqueue-engine -p pqueue-conformance
-p pqueue-server: 0 failed. AC-TXN-1..7 all green. fmt clean; clippy -D warnings clean; cargo deny green.

NON-BLOCKING deferred follow-ups (documented in code, not corruption): manifest tombstone + floor-entry compaction (bytes are
reclaimed via segment deletion; manifest JSON grows); orphan-object GC after a failed branch cleanup (harmless garbage since the
partial branch is non-readable); a branch created against an actively-trimming source may need a retry (conservative fail-closed).
summary: bounded-recovery retention floor -> objectlog segment-object reclamation gated by async-apply debt; AC-TXN-3 preserved both paths; codex-APPROVED after 8 adversarial rounds (raw+group ts, crash/takeover/behind-image, branch concurrency + atomic marker); AC-TXN-5A row pass
